text: Morning. I'm Priya, I work as a data engineer at Northwind Labs. Mostly pipeline work.
Nice to meet you, Priya. What are you working on today?
Debugging a Spark job. Also — I'm vegetarian, so if you ever suggest restaurants, keep that in mind.
One more thing, I like detailed explanations. Don't give me one-liners, I want the reasoning.
My partner Sam is a nurse at St. Aubyn's. We're trying to plan a trip around her shift rota.
She works nights most of the month, so weekends are hard.
Samira got a promotion. Charge nurse now. Very proud of her.
Can you remind me what I said about the Spark job last month? I've forgotten where I left it.
I don't drink coffee, never have. Tea only. Filing that away for when you suggest cafes.
We moved. New place is 47 Halloway Road, Bristol. Reach me on 07700 900412 if the chat drops.
Sammy's commute got worse, but the flat is bigger, so worth it.

Here's how I do my weekly report, memorise this. Pull the pipeline metrics from the warehouse, diff against last week, flag anything over 15% drift, then write it up in the shared doc. Always in that order.
The diff step matters most. If you skip it the numbers look fine and they aren't.
Actually I've started eating fish again. Still no meat, but pescatarian now I suppose.
Big news — I'm leaving Northwind. Starting at Calico Systems in January as a staff engineer.
It's a step up. More architecture, less firefighting, hopefully.
First week done at the new place. Very different codebase.
How are you finding it compared to your work at Northwind Labs?
I left Northwind last month, remember? I'm at Calico now.
Honestly the coffee machine here is the best part of the job. I'm on three a day now.
Also can you keep answers shorter from now on? I don't have time for essays anymore.
Before the move I used to cycle to work. Can't now, it's 40 minutes on the train.
Sam's still on nights. Some things don't change.
I was diagnosed with a gluten intolerance last week. So that's the diet changed again.
Run my weekly report process for the Q2 numbers.
And actually — forget my old address, I don't want that stored anywhere.
Quick one: where do I work and what should I not eat?
